review_notes: Read all 1385 C lines and 163 header lines, binding every original candidate SHA.
The initialization-liveness defect is recorded separately: GPS/RTC validity is cleared before valid time is required. This does not zero independently implemented leaves.
R+D permit RAM/HAL adaptation. Direct did not receive the fixed API, so A only clarifies the common environment and adds no signature obligations absent from R.
There are 89 leaves designated in advance for static review and 13 non-static leaves marked unassessed. No code changes or Host/API calls were made.
